title: Caching and Embeddings
summary: This module provides core caching mechanisms for DSPy, including synchronous and asynchronous wrappers, disk serialization with security features, and specialized caching for embedding computations. It ensures efficient reuse of results from expensive operations.

nodes.label: Configure DSPy Cache
nodes.title: configure_cache
nodes.description: Sets up the global DSPy cache with specified disk and memory caching options, including size limits and pickle restrictions for security.

nodes.label: Initialize DSPy Cache
nodes.title: _get_dspy_cache
nodes.description: Retrieves or initializes the DSPy cache, defaulting to disk and memory caching, with a fallback to memory-only if disk initialization fails (e.g., in restricted environments).

nodes.label: Apply Sync Caching
nodes.title: sync_wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that provides synchronous caching logic, checking for cached results before executing a function and storing new results upon completion.

nodes.label: Apply Async Caching
nodes.title: async_wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that provides asynchronous caching logic, checking for cached results before awaiting a function and storing new results upon completion.

nodes.label: Secure Disk Serialization
nodes.title: _RestrictedDisk
nodes.description: A specialized disk storage class that enforces restricted pickle deserialization for security, allowing only a predefined set of safe types to prevent arbitrary code execution.

nodes.label: Cache Synchronous Embeddings
nodes.title: _cached_compute_embeddings
nodes.description: Computes embeddings synchronously, leveraging the global DSPy caching mechanism to store and retrieve results for performance optimization.

nodes.label: Cache Asynchronous Embeddings
nodes.title: _cached_acompute_embeddings
nodes.description: Computes embeddings asynchronously, utilizing the global DSPy caching mechanism to store and retrieve results for performance optimization in async contexts.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Cache Instance
nodes.title: dspy.cache
nodes.description: The central cache instance used across DSPy for storing and retrieving results of expensive operations like LLM calls or embedding computations.

nodes.label: Core Caching Logic
nodes.title: Cache
nodes.description: The underlying caching mechanism (e.g., `Cache` class) that manages both in-memory and on-disk storage, handling key generation and data persistence.

nodes.label: Embedding Model Service
nodes.title: LLM/Embedding Model
nodes.description: An external or internal service responsible for generating vector embeddings from input text or data, which can be a costly operation.

groups.label: Cache Management
groups.title: Cache Management
groups.description: Components responsible for configuring, initializing, and providing the core caching infrastructure for DSPy.

groups.label: Caching Wrappers
groups.title: Caching Wrappers
groups.description: Decorators that enable transparent caching for both synchronous and asynchronous function calls, improving performance by storing and retrieving results.

groups.label: Embedding Caching
groups.title: Embedding Caching
groups.description: Specific functions designed to cache the results of embedding computations, reducing redundant calls to embedding models.

groups.label: Security & Serialization
groups.title: Security & Serialization
groups.description: Handles secure disk serialization for the cache, restricting deserialization to known safe types to mitigate security risks.
